source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk is TRUE or action is delete; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role is operator outside context external; a trusted approve prefers deny at priority 80. Action export in context external prefers allow at priority 70. Role guest or context sandbox prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk is TRUE or action is delete; critical cases require allow.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90.
Trusted means role is operator outside context external; a trusted approve prefers deny at priority 80.
Action export in context external prefers allow at priority 70.
Role guest or context sandbox prefers review at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or (event.action == delete)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == operator) and (event.context != external)

predicate UnknownRisk(event):
    event.risk == UNKNOWN

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == external)

predicate GuestOrSandbox(event):
    (event.role == guest) or (event.context == sandbox)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when (UnknownRisk(event)) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedApprove:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == approve)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80, forbid label = review

rule ExportInExternal:
    when (event.action == export) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule GuestOrSandboxCase:
    when GuestOrSandbox(event)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when (event.role != operator) and (event.role != guest)
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rendered_bundle: Verified decision list. Find a line whose stated field conditions all match the input, then return its label. Unstated fields can have any value. Matching lines agree.
If risk=TRUE, return allow.
If action=delete, risk=FALSE, return allow.
If action=delete, context=sandbox, return allow.
If action=delete, context=internal, return allow.
If action=export, context=external, risk=FALSE, return allow.
If role=operator, action=approve, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If role=operator, action=export, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return deny.
If role=operator, action=export, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return deny.
If role=operator, action=approve, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return deny.
If role=operator, action=approve, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return deny.
If role=analyst, action=export, context=internal, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If role=analyst, action=approve, context=internal, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If role=analyst, action=approve, context=external, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If role=guest, action=approve, risk=FALSE, return review.
If action=export, context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, return review.
If role=guest, action=export, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If role=guest, action=export, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If role=guest, action=export, context=internal, risk=FALSE, return review.
If role=guest, action=approve, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If role=guest, action=approve, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If role=analyst, action=export, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If role=analyst, action=export, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If role=analyst, action=approve, context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If role=analyst, action=approve, context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, return review.
If role=analyst, action=approve, context=internal, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If context=external, risk=UNKNOWN, return uncertain.
If role=operator, action=export, context=internal, risk=FALSE, return uncertain.
deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are deny, allow, review, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
